verdict.rationale: Recurring schedules are a fair question for a data portal and API service, since saved searches with periodic alerts or scheduled extracts are plausible features. The evidence shows only on-demand GET requests and a one-off option to receive an extract download URL by email ('emailId=Yes'), which is a single action, not a recurring schedule. There is no documented way to register scheduled or recurring jobs or workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
